title: Woman shot in home
article: The nine-year-old daughter of an Alert Bay woman who was shot and killed by an RCMP officer Friday was in the home when the shooting happened, police said Sunday.
"We have heard that she was hiding but we're unable to confirm that," said RCMP Sgt. Lee Omilusik.

Forty-year-old Lorraine Jacobson, who also used the last name Moon, was shot by a police constable at about 8 p.m. Friday night. She was taken to hospital in Alert Bay, on Cormorant Island, just off the coast of Port MacNeill, where she was pronounced dead.
Jacobson had two other boys. Omilusik said police aren't sure where they were Friday night but said they weren't in the house.

The shooting happened after the constable, an eight-year veteran who had been in Alert Bay for two years, responded alone to a call for a domestic disturbance in the Whe la la U First Nations community. When he arrived and entered the house, Omilusik said he was confronted by a woman with a large butcher knife.
